\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz,graphicx,relsize}
\newcommand\scaleprobe[2]{%
  \setbox0=\hbox{#2}%
  \typeout{SCALEBOX #1: \the\wd0,\the\ht0,\the\dp0}%
}
\begin{document}
\scaleprobe{half}{\scalebox{.5}{$\times1$}}
\scaleprobe{non-optical}{\scalebox{.37}{$\times1$}}
\scaleprobe{larger-script}{\scalebox{1.5}{$x_1$}}
\scaleprobe{fraction}{\scalebox{.5}{$\frac{1}{x+y}$}}
\scaleprobe{eight}{{\footnotesize\scalebox{.5}{$\times1$}}}
\scaleprobe{twelve}{{\large\scalebox{.5}{$x_1$}}}
\scaleprobe{inside-large}{\scalebox{.5}{\large$\times1$}}
\scaleprobe{nested}{\scalebox{.5}{\scalebox{1.5}{$\sin x$}}}
\scaleprobe{double}{\scalebox{2}{$\times1$}}
\scaleprobe{relative}{\scalebox{.5}{$\mathlarger{\mathlarger{x}}$}}
\end{document}
